questions.solution:
Since the options are based on inequality, we can initially assume the nearest perfect cubes and then proceed to solve the question.

As we know, ∛8 = 2

We can write,

⇒ ∛9 > 2 ----(1)

Similarly, ∛125 = 5

⇒ ∛126 > 5 ----(2)

Also, ∛216 = 6

⇒ ∛217 > 6 ----(3)

Adding the three equations, we get,

⇒ ∛9 + ∛126 + ∛217 > 2 + 5 + 6

⇒ ∛a > 13

⇒ a > (13)³

∴ a > 2197
